subject: Private listing eligibility & co-sell evidence for DataForge (GCP)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@dataforge.com>, Elena Rios <elena.rios@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private listing eligibility & co-sell evidence for DataForge (GCP)

Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. DataForge is ready to move toward a private listing on GCP and are asking about co-sell / "sell with" alignment across marketplaces (GCP + AWS). Before we put together the mutual action plan, can you confirm a few items so we can scope the intake properly: 

- Which evidentiary artifacts do we need to include for a GCP private listing vs an AWS Private Offer? (SOC2, PCI, integration runbook, telemetry examples)
- Does AWS/GCP require a separate co-sell enablement package (customer success joint playbook) or will the marketplace listing metadata suffice?
- Who signs the private offer PO on your side and do we need a signed SOW in advance to enable co-sell/credits?
- Any SKU / pricing guidance for a 30-day pilot (metered hourly vs fixed monthly)?

I've attached a short checklist (partner-evidence-checklist.pdf) that we normally use; consider it a starting point. Ben + Naomi are cc'd to help with evidence gathering and upstream GTM asks.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Thursday 10/29 to agree MAP and deliverables. If that works, Elena — can you confirm the marketplace intake window / expected review SLA for privatelisting?

Thanks,

— Jordan Blake
Head of Alliances (Marketplace Partnerships)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@dataforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Rios <elena.rios@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@dataforge.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private listing eligibility & co-sell evidence for DataForge (GCP)

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side: 

- Evidence: We can provide SOC2 Type II report, a short security summary (1 pager), an architecture/integration runbook, and a 2–3 minute demo recording showing the GCP connector. For AWS we expect similar artifacts; AWS also asked for a billing/metering diagram for how the SKU will be consumed.
- Co-sell package: GCP typically needs a co-sell enablement doc + at least one joint customer reference or pilot commitment. AWS sometimes asks for a proof of concept (POC) acceptance criteria doc to enable rev-share classification.
- PO/SOW: We can sign a PO for the private offer; we prefer SOW to be light (services, if any) and handle the pilot via a credit schedule.
- SKU/pricing: For the pilot we propose a metered hourly SKU with a capped monthly ceiling. If the marketplace needs a fixed SKU for listing, we can create a trial SKU and map to metered billing on our backend.

Timeline: if we provide the SOC2 + runbook by EOD Friday (10/30), what's your normal internal review window to submit to GCP marketplace?

Link: I uploaded a short SOC summary and initial SKU mapping to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive

Samir
Head of Partnerships
DataForge

--
Samir Patel
DataForge | samir.patel@dataforge.com

Quick update from runtime/integration: 

- SKU mapping: metered hourly SKU with a capped monthly ceiling is compatible. We will need a mapping table (SKU -> internal plan id -> meter name). Samir, can you push that csv into the shared folder?
- Telemetry: marketplace reviewers typically want a sample of ingestion logs (anonymized), a latency histogram for first token and 95% P50/P95, and an example billing report for a single customer month. Redact PII and we'll reformat.
- Timeline: If DataForge drops SOC2 + runbook by EOD 10/30, we can assemble the submission package and submit to GCP by 11/03. AWS private offer submission usually takes 5–7 business days after we provide the signed PO.

I've started a draft Mutual Action Plan and attached it (MAP-draft.xlsx) — added two milestones: "Marketplace submission" (11/03) and "Pilot kickoff" (11/15). Jordan / Ben / Naomi: please review the GTM milestones and add customer reference targets.

Proposed next steps:
- Samir: upload SOC2 summary + SKU csv to shared folder (by 10/30)
- Jordan/Ben/Naomi: review MAP-draft.xlsx and add GTM asks (by 10/30)
- Elena: confirm if AWS private offer needs additional classification paperwork for co-sell (if so, link appreciated)

Thanks — Vivek
Sr. Director, Runtime Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-draft.xlsx (Excel, 22KB)
